description_en: Updates the information about a Lingjun connection instance, including the peak bandwidth and name of the Lingjun connection instance
description_zh: 更新灵骏连接实例的部分信息，包括灵骏连接实例的带宽峰值和名称
kebab_example: aliyun eflo update-vcc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vcc-id vcc-cn-zvp2w222001 --bandwidth 1000 --vcc-name vcc-heyuan-backup --order-id 20006627643 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVcc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Lingjun connection instance
parameters.name: vcc_id

parameters.help_en: The peak bandwidth of the Lingjun connection instance. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 1000 to 400000
parameters.help_zh: 灵骏连接实例的带宽峰值，单位mbps。取值范围：1000~400000
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The name of the Lingjun connection instance
parameters.name: vcc_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the order placed on the instance
parameters.name: order_id
